caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular swatches arranged in two rows of three on a beige background. The top left swatch features diagonal black lines intersected by vertical wavy red lines on a white background. The top center swatch displays a plaid pattern with red, white, black, and beige intersecting lines forming squares. The top right swatch shows a beige background with small red flowers and brown abstract leaf and block designs. The bottom left swatch exhibits a diamond pattern created by brown and beige tones with darker outlines. The bottom center swatch contains narrow vertical brick-like rectangles in beige, black, and blue, arranged in alternating columns. The bottom right swatch presents a black background with a red floral pattern and vines distributed across the surface.
title: Materials from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
